description: This file defines an API for notifying code about changes to the current working directory. It provides functions for registering, unregistering, and triggering notifications on directory changes, as well as helper functions for path reparenting.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Register a callback to be invoked when the current working directory changes.

methods.name: chdir_notify_unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previous directory change notification callback.

methods.name: chdir_notify_reparent
methods.description: Update a relative path based on a new root directory.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Change the current working directory and notify registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparent a relative path from an old root to a new root, handling potential absolute paths.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
